scope: Sanitized GPU-related Perfetto data-source descriptor roster from one exact query snapshot; not a universal device capability claim

rawInput.readMode: exact bytes; no CR stripping, filtering, transcoding, or normalization

schemaFields: GpuCounterSpec.counter_id field 1, name field 2, numerator_units field 7, denominator_units field 8

snapshotFinding: This exact snapshot advertised no GPU counter specs in its GPU-related sources.
limits: The conclusion applies only to this captured service snapshot and exposed source roster.
Absence of advertised counter descriptors does not prove counters are unavailable on the device generally, through other APIs, or in other Perfetto configurations.
No GPU source was configured, started, or sampled by this offline decode.
Source IDs, producers, process names, serials, and unrelated descriptor names are deliberately omitted.
